purpose: Compete for useful attention without allowing demand, compression, generation, advertising, or delivery to manufacture warrant.
invariants: Demand may create an assignment but never evidence.
A source statement remains attributable to its source until an authorized editorial act adopts a narrower newsroom claim.
No public surface may create a factual commitment not licensed by the article, its cited evidence, its uncertainty, or a declared editorial stance.
A manuscript is not publishable unless deterministic gates clear and the latest exact-manuscript independent editorial judgment accepts it.
Corrections, clarifications, updates, and retractions must propagate to every dependent headline, article, feed, card, sitemap, metadata record, and syndication surface that Koios controls.
Audience demand, attention, advertising, revenue, provider cost, and editorial warrant are recorded as distinct facts and never substituted for one another.
Newsroom learning may propose a replay, route review, observation period, or standards review from durable outcomes; it may not itself publish, execute the replay, alter a route, or amend law.
LLMs may produce prose, images, or bounded choices; deterministic code owns serialization, digests, admission, ledgers, and publication transitions.
A provider is selected by the cheapest route that satisfies the declared quality and evidence requirements; zero marginal price never waives those requirements.
No deployment target becomes authoritative without parity evidence, an accepted bilateral EVM effect seam, a rollback route, and an explicit cutover act.

A public privacy surface must describe the requests the exact publication artifact actually emits; suspended advertising or attention may not be described as active, and active third-party carriers may not be described as absent.

Advertising units, placements, provider requests, seller declarations, performance receipts, and revenue enter Koios only under provider-authored or provider-accepted evidence; Koios never invents ads.txt authority.
